items.title: Hungary to shut sole nuclear plant for first time on Sunday
items.description: Record-low water levels on the Danube forced the Paks plant offline, leaving Hungary facing a potential power crunch. In neighboring Serbia, energy production at two hydroelectric plants has also been reduced.
